intro: Dallas listings advertise 10x10 units from roughly $47 (and "$1 first month" deals), while typical non-climate 10x10 market rates run about $103–$110/month. Once the move-in special ends and the first existing-customer increase lands, your six-month average is well above the number on the banner.
data_asof: Aug–Oct 2026 (StorageCafe, StorageUnitCosts, Storage Stats) and Mar 2026 (Extra Space)

units.notes: Locker / closet size. Fixed fees dominate the true cost at this size. Climate-controlled ~$46–$54.
Walk-in closet; dorm or studio overflow. Climate-controlled ~$71–$88.
Most rented size. DFW metro non-climate average $103 (Storage Stats, Oct 2026), down 8.7% YoY — leverage when negotiating. Climate-controlled ~$122–$160.
Three-bedroom house or a car. Climate-controlled ~$231–$338; outdoor/drive-up cheaper.

local_tips: DFW has one of the largest storage supplies in the US (1,500+ facilities tracked by Storage Stats) and asking rents are falling, so competing quotes are easy to get.
Dallas rates tend to be lowest around December and highest in late summer (StorageCafe); if you can time a move-in, winter promos are usually better.
Extra Space lists a $50 admin fee in Dallas — higher than our $29 default; adjust the calculator if your facility charges more.
